obligations.description: Tapping a category button that has no recipes shows 'U ovoj kategoriji nema recepata'.
Before selecting any category, the screen shows the text 'Izaberite kategoriju'.
Tapping a recipe name in the category detail leaves the categories screen ('Jela' heading is no longer shown).
Tapping the 'Jela' category button shows the heading 'Jela' and the recipes in that category.
When no recipes are favorited, the screen shows 'Nemate omiljenih recepata'.

intentionalDifferences.reason: Favorite button on each card may show only a star icon without a visible text label; if it has no accessible name a test cannot address it by name.

obligations.description: Tapping 'Dodaj sastojke u listu za kupovinu' shows the message 'Sastojci su dodati u listu za kupovinu' on this page.
Tapping 'Nazad na recepte' leaves the detail screen ('Nazad na recepte' is no longer shown).
Tapping 'Smanji porcije' decreases the value shown next to 'Porcije:' by 1.
Tapping 'Povećaj porcije' increases the value shown next to 'Porcije:' by 1.
Opening a detail page with a non-existent recipe ID shows 'Recept nije pronađen' and the back link 'Nazad na recepte'.

intentionalDifferences.reason: Two-column layout (380px ingredients | 1fr steps) designed for desktop; on a phone ingredients and steps must stack vertically. The same content is shown, only the layout changes.

obligations.description: Tapping 'Deserti' in the category filter shows only recipes from the 'Deserti' category; tapping 'Sve kategorije' shows recipes from all categories again.
Tapping the recipe name 'Sarma' in the list leaves the recipe list ('Pretraga' is no longer shown).
Typing a name that matches no recipe in 'Pretraga' shows 'Nema recepata za zadatu pretragu'.
Typing 'Sarma' in the 'Pretraga' field shows only the recipe named 'Sarma' in the list.

intentionalDifferences.reason: Ingredient details appear only on mouse hover; touch screens have no hover.
Sorting only changes the order; a test cannot check order.
Favorite button in each row shows only a star icon with no visible text label; tests cannot address it by name.

obligations.description: Filling 'Namirnica' with 'Mleko' and tapping 'Dodaj' shows 'Mleko' in the list and shows 'Kupljeno: 0 od 1'.
When no items are bought, the 'Obriši kupljene' button is visible and disabled.
With no items the screen shows 'Lista za kupovinu je prazna'.

intentionalDifferences.reason: Checkbox in the first column has no visible label; tests cannot toggle it by name.

flows.description: Navigate to a recipe detail ('/recepti/:id'), tap the favorite button, then go to '/omiljeni': the recipe appears as a card in the favorites grid.
On the recipe list ('/'), tap the favorite star button on a recipe row, then go to '/omiljeni': the recipe appears as a card in the favorites grid.
On a recipe detail page, tap 'Dodaj sastojke u listu za kupovinu', then go to '/kupovina': the ingredients of that recipe appear in the shopping list.
On '/kategorije', select a category (e.g. 'Jela'), then tap a recipe name in the list: the detail screen shows that recipe's name and 'Porcije:'.
On '/omiljeni' (with at least one favorited recipe), tap a recipe card name: the detail screen shows that recipe's name and 'Porcije:'.
On the recipe list ('/'), tap a recipe name (e.g. 'Sarma'): the detail screen shows the recipe name 'Sarma' as its title and 'Porcije:' with the default serving count.

Add a favorite from the recipe list or detail, then open '/omiljeni': the recipe card is shown. Clicking its favorite button removes it from the grid; if no favorites remain, 'Nemate omiljenih recepata' is shown.
